from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityEnrollment(BaseModel):
    """One university's enrollment data point from a CDS report."""
    university: str | None = Field(description="Name of the university")
    enrollment_count: int | None = Field(description="Grand Total All Students enrollment figure")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period/date in YYYY-MM format")
    source_section: str | None = Field(description="Which section of the CDS contains this data, e.g., Section B1")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    university_enrollments: list[UniversityEnrollment]
